elements.label: Figure 3.22
elements.description:
Grouped bar chart. Chart type: vertical grouped bars. Y-axis: 'Share of households (%)', scale 0 to 80 in steps of 10. X-axis categories, each split into Ethnic minority and Kinh: Agricultural services, Aquaculture, By-products, Forestry, Fruit, Industrial crops, Livestock, Rice, Staples. Legend: 2010 (teal), 2020 (orange). Values are not printed, so approximate readings:
- Agricultural services: Ethnic minority 2010 ~1, 2020 ~1; Kinh 2010 ~1.5, 2020 ~0.5
- Aquaculture: Ethnic minority 2010 ~31, 2020 ~19; Kinh 2010 ~16, 2020 ~8
- By-products: Ethnic minority 2010 ~60, 2020 ~48; Kinh 2010 ~38, 2020 ~17
- Forestry: Ethnic minority 2010 ~69, 2020 ~56; Kinh 2010 ~10, 2020 ~3
- Fruit: Ethnic minority 2010 ~50, 2020 ~34; Kinh 2010 ~27, 2020 ~15
- Industrial crops: Ethnic minority 2010 ~37, 2020 ~21; Kinh 2010 ~20, 2020 ~11
- Livestock: Ethnic minority 2010 ~72, 2020 ~66; Kinh 2010 ~40, 2020 ~27
- Rice: Ethnic minority 2010 ~72, 2020 ~62; Kinh 2010 ~39, 2020 ~22
- Staples: Ethnic minority 2010 ~71, 2020 ~58; Kinh 2010 ~31, 2020 ~16

For nearly every activity, ethnic minority households have a higher share than Kinh households in both years, with the largest gaps in forestry, livestock, rice and staples, and shares generally falling from 2010 to 2020.
